team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 288 turns vs floor 15 (5 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Online and offline research materials and ordinary software are allowed.
No contact with anyone outside the team during the case window.
Deliver a slide deck / strategic report suitable for oral presentation.
Do not modify the submission after the lock/deadline.
Business Case is a team competition; communication only with IEO officials and teammates (no outsiders).
Business Case lasts two days: preparation day + presentation day; presentations must be English slide-supported oral talks.
During preparation: any online and offline materials allowed; contacting other people for help is prohibited.
All teams submit slides by Steering Committee deadline before Opening Ceremony; no slide changes afterward.
Business Case contributes 50 final points (raw then Z-normalized); group stage then Finals for group winners; criterion scores use median of judges.
Contrast: Economics/Finance individual exams ban smartphones/electronics; permitted instruments listed ≤1 month ahead (not the Business Case tools regime).

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain / editor
duties: Own the deliverable's structure and cut material that does not earn points.
Resolve disagreements between analysts before they reach the final text.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: analyst
duties: Gather the evidence the recommendation rests on.
Separate what the sources say from what the team infers.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: quant / modeler
duties: Build the numbers: valuation, models, and sensitivity checks.
State assumptions explicitly and show which results depend on them.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: research lead
duties: Decide which questions the research must answer and in what order.
Kill lines of inquiry that will not change the recommendation.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: slide / report designer
duties: Turn analysis into a structure a judge can follow in one pass.
Cut slides and sections that do not carry an argument.

answer_format: Submit a structured report or slide outline covering analysis, recommendation, and evidence.

submission.adaptation: Official entries are slide files; the runner submits the deck as structured text.

rules_text: International Economics Olympiad — Business Case. The team of 5 prepares one research deliverable that expert judges score against a rubric. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: Preparation window plus presentation (often ~24h prep).

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/
